accessions: GSE294565 (GEO lists PMID 37872294; paper DA.p1 names BioProject PRJNA1029003)
assay: bulk mRNA-seq of tibialis anterior (TA), Novogene; plus NanoString GeoMx spatial RNA-seq (not in this GEO series)
primary_estimand: Effect of BI01 (OS) vs vehicle (OV) on the TA transcriptome of old mice 7 and 35 days after BaCl2 injury (S2.5.p1, FIG6). The only exercise-like stimulus in the paper, 28-day mechanical overload of plantaris by synergist ablation (S2.6.p1, S4.3.p1, FIG8-9), was assessed by histology and muscle mass only; no RNA-seq was done on overloaded muscle.
planned_contrasts: OS vs OV, 7 d post-BaCl2, n=4/group (S2.5.p1, FIG6a-b; paper: 'hundreds of genes', no count given)
OS vs OV, 35 d post-BaCl2, n=4/group (S2.5.p1, FIG6d-e; no count given)
sample_inclusion: 32 TA libraries: YV/OV PBS, YV/OV/OS 7 dpi and 35 dpi (no OS PBS libraries deposited)
repeated_measure_unit: PBS and BaCl2 were injected unilaterally (ABS.p1), but the library names give no animal ID, so contralateral pairing is not recorded
paper_method: Partek Flow: STAR to GRCm39, Partek E/M (Ensembl 103), min 10 counts filter, DESeq2 (S4.11.p1)
paper_results: DEG counts not stated; Tpt1 up in OS at 7 d, not different at 35 d (S2.5.p1, FIG6c,f)
